summary: Bending Spoons S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Bending Spoons US Inc., entered into a securities purchase agreement to acquire all outstanding shares of Formagrid Inc (d/b/a Airtable) from Formagrid Holdings LLC in an all-cash transaction. The deal values Formagrid at an enterprise value of $1.285 billion, implying an equity value of approximately $2.25 billion including net cash, subject to customary purchase price adjustments. Closing is expected later this year, subject to regulatory approvals and customary conditions, with a termination date of February 4, 2027. The agreement includes customary reps, warranties, and termination rights. The transaction follows a reorganization separating the Hyperagent business line. Regulatory approval timing and potential termination risks are key watch items for risk-arbitrageurs.
